title: Companion monitor edit and pause
description: Run check-pr-monitor-roundtrip.mts setup and the desktop roundtrip recipe first, then supply ROUNDTRIP_TAG/PR_URL/GW_URL and the monitor_id. The unavailable account cannot read provider data or start work.

open-route.intent: Open the native screen backed by the same monitor edited on desktop.

wait-screen.intent: The connected native monitor controls are available.

monitors.intent: The shared subscription is reachable from the monitored PR list.

scroll-monitor.intent: The operator can reach configuration actions below the provider evidence.

edit.intent: Reopen the subscription without changing its identity or check names.

scroll-fields.intent: Polling settings are reachable below subscription identity and policy.

interval.intent: Change polling to fifteen minutes while preserving complete check names.

keyboard.intent: Finish editing the interval before saving the native form.

scroll-save.intent: The save action is reachable below monitoring limits.

save.intent: Persist the mobile configuration through the shared gateway API.

verify-native.intent: A new gateway read proves the mobile interval edit retained the comma-bearing check name.

capture.intent: The updated native subscription shows its policy and available actions.

pause.intent: Pause this exact subscription without stopping other monitoring interests.

verify-pause.intent: The gateway reports the mobile pause to other clients.

cleanup.intent: Stop the validation subscription and leave no test monitoring active.
